notes:
Quick account summary:
- Mid-market B2B SaaS: product analytics platform used by e-comm and fintech customers. Heavy chat UI + embeddings for product search and reranking.
- Currently on competitor LLM API (layered pricing, high tail latencies). Investigating migration for cost predictability and improved SLAs.

POC highlight (Hosted API -> Dedicated path):
- 2-week Hosted POC completed (Jan-Feb 2026): ran 3 workloads: chat (customer-facing help assistant), embeddings for semantic search, and reranker for search results.
- Performance: median chat latency on Redwood hosted ~180ms at 1k token windows (target <200ms). Peak throughput simulated 220 reqs/sec with continuous batching.
- Cost: initial estimates show 20-35% unit-cost reduction vs incumbent when using Redwood batching + KV caching suggestions.
- Migration items: tokenization differences caused prompt-parity drift on 8% of test prompts (more in instruction-following edge cases). Found deterministic divergence on system prompt handling and newer stop-token semantics.

Technical / compatibility notes:
- Engineering wants a compatibility shim that accepts incumbent API shapes (headers + inference params) to reduce frontend changes during cutover. Redwood team demoed API adapter pattern; SE recommended canary route to split 10% traffic for 2 weeks.
- Regression testing harness: they provided a 1.2k prompt eval set (mix of production traffic + edge cases). Redwood Optimize proposed batch quantization recommendations; evaluating POC artifacts in Drive link.
- Fallback strategy: automatic fallback to incumbent provider for requests failing prompt-parity tolerance or SLOs. SE set up metric monitors for divergence rate and hallucination score.

Security / Compliance:
- Must pass security review: SSO/SAML + SOC2 required. Data residency note: EU customers require region pinning for embeddings index (they currently serve some EU tenants). KMS integration mandatory for Dedicated.
- Legal flagged retention policy differences; needs confirmed retention_controls for hosted logs.

- Buying group: Head of Product (Priya Shah), VP Eng (Marcus Lee), Procurement (Olivia Grant). AE Samira leading pricing conversations.
- Expected ARR ask: committed Dedicated capacity + Optimize add-on. Looking for 12–24 month commit with runway for growth.
